**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The audit/inspection architecture in this Transfer and Servicing Agreement runs entirely *in our favour*:

- **§ 3.6 (p0131)** — Cellco as Servicer must maintain records and, once per calendar year on reasonable notice, give the Issuer, Depositor, Administrator, Owner Trustee and Indenture Trustee access to conduct a performance review, at Cellco's offices during its business hours.
- **§ 3.9(e) (p0146)** — Cellco as Custodian must give the Depositor, Issuer and Indenture Trustee access to the Receivable Files and receivables systems to review the Receivables.
- **Regulation AB items (p0437, p1045 et seq.)** — Compliance Statement, Servicing Assessment, Attestation Report and Annual Certification are all Cellco deliverables, produced at its own cost.

No clause anywhere grants the Servicer, Marketing Agent or Custodian any audit, inspection or verification right against the Issuer or Depositor, imposes audit costs on us, or permits access to our systems. The rule's parameters (frequency, notice, cost allocation, system access binding the customer) are therefore not engaged, and the existing clauses benefit us — so they are left untouched.
